Cleaned it up. Two things worth your attention:

1. **Contradiction removed**: the prompt said both "merge as soon as CI turns green" and "never merge without explicit human approval." I kept the human-approval rule (safer default) and dropped the auto-merge line — that conflict was almost certainly why the model looked like it was ignoring instructions. Flag if you actually wanted auto-merge-on-green.
2. **Undefined threshold**: "diff size threshold" for `#big-changes` routing was never specified — left a `<!-- TODO: define threshold -->` marker rather than guessing a number.

Also trimmed the "CRITICAL, NO EXCEPTIONS!!!" shouting and other redundant phrasing throughout — same rules, fewer tokens, no more competing emphasis drowning out other instructions.
